hard_failures.label: D1 residue: the demoted set-based visibility reading survives verbatim in AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH
hard_failures.claim: The AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH conclusion still says 'every future-inextendible causal geodesic contained in J-(I+) is complete' (line 406). That is the exact set-based union reading that D1 removed from AF-WCC-VAC-GEN and demoted to registered variant SET, whose adjudication text says the set-based form is 'never a second predicate' and 'the two readings must never be interchanged' (lines 63-65, 69). The variants block registers SET only under AF-WCC-VAC-GEN, so two classes that share conclusion_type=weak_cosmic_censorship now carry non-equivalent visibility predicates.
hard_failures.required_fix: either restate the AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH conclusion with the single-q TAIL predicate (as AF-WCC-VAC-GEN does), or register the set-based reading for that class with its own variant id and falsifier and declare that weak_cosmic_censorship is predicate-parameterised.
hard_failures.falsifier: Show that 'contained in J-(I+)' at line 406 is not the set-based union reading - e.g. exhibit a taxonomy line defining J-(I+) there as a single J^-(q); in the pinned file J-(I+) appears only in the variant SET definition (line 84) and in this conclusion.

hard_failures.label: D3 recorded as resolved for 'each class' but not discharged for AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH
hard_failures.claim: class_scope_adjudication.resolved_divergences D3 states 'the comeager quantifier is now stated explicitly in each class conclusion text and bound before the data' (line 72). Three of four conclusion texts carry an explicit 'comeager set G_{s,delta}' bound before the data; AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH says only 'For generic data in the class, ...' (line 405) with no comeager set. The file is therefore internally inconsistent about its own adjudicated resolution.
hard_failures.required_fix: either state the comeager quantifier explicitly in the scalar-class conclusion, or amend D3's scope to the three vacuum classes and record the scalar-class genericity quantifier as unresolved (its genericity_kind is already 'unresolved' and owned by L0/L1).
hard_failures.falsifier: Quote a comeager set bound before the data in the AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH conclusion text (lines 402-408), or show D3's text scopes to the vacuum classes only.

hard_failures.label: C2/C0 schema_owner pointers target a map-recorded legacy non-class artifact and the superseded node name F2
hard_failures.claim: Both SCC classes point their provenance.schema_owner at 'F2 (artifact schemas/af_scc_regularities.yaml, section C2/C0)' (lines 305, 374). The map records schemas/af_scc_regularities.yaml in legacy_artifacts as a 'non-class aggregator (legacy combined C0/C2 file); never a class artifact', and the live canonical class schemas are schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml (F2a) and schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml (F2b). A reader following the pointer lands on a retired artifact under a node id the map no longer uses.
hard_failures.required_fix: repoint the two schema_owner fields at the split canonical class schemas (nodes F2a/F2b) or at a hash-pinned byte-identical publication copy; same defect class as F-094-5 on F1.
hard_failures.falsifier: Show that schemas/af_scc_regularities.yaml is the canonical class artifact for F2 (i.e. not in map legacy_artifacts and named by the class schemas' own bindings).
